disposition: Experimental variant. The same organization as oneport-results.json, emitted with the command-split lift in the generic backend: commit, start and bank selection decode the raw command, so the loader's data port has no path to the scheduler, the cached word or the policy's registers. Validation and mapped screen below; routed results, if any, are in the matching physical manifest.

fixed_contract: Ports, module name, register layout and host-port timing are the predecessor's. Only combinational logic differs: command predicates other than push decode the raw command.

structural_levels.prediction: The data port reaches only the loader's registers; the register-launched family into the fetched words is the deepest path and is one level shallower than the predecessor's, so the model expects the data-launched violations to disappear and the register family to stay where it was.

boundary: Mapped screen only in this manifest: no routed or extracted timing claim. No Yosys sequential equivalence to the composed RTL (different register sets), no Lean read-back of this RTL, technology-mapped equivalence, metastability or electrical claim. The refinement and the oracle runs hold on programs satisfying the readiness rule; the UART receiver as compiled is outside it.
